title: Tokenize design system artifact bundle
description: Closed schemas for every durable artifact exchanged by the end-to-end tokenization state machine.

canonicalGroupProposal.description: PROPOSAL, not a decision. Records what the official canonicalizer would produce under the options actually used. Risk class and applicability are decided downstream against scope policy.

compilerCanonicalGroupFingerprint.description: Group-level canonical proposal from the official canonicalizer. null when the compiler is unavailable or the group is unchanged. Optional: absence means the producer predates the projection, never 'nothing to collapse'.

exactCoverage.$comment: RATCHET, nao afrouxamento: artifact-contract.mjs ja exige === true em codigo; o schema mentia sobre a propria severidade dizendo apenas boolean.

exactCoverageLedger.$comment: A forma que analyzeExactCoverage produz (visual-contract.mjs). `invalidCaptures` e `orphanMetadata` sao fatos do DIRETORIO no instante da coleta — o contrato nao tem como reconstrui-los depois, entao ou entram no artefato ou se perdem.

binaryEvidenceRef.$comment: Referencia a um BINARIO (PNG, heatmap): exatamente {path, sha256}, SEM artifactType. A ausencia e obrigatoria e mecanica — collectArtifactRefs so coleta objetos cujas chaves sejam artifactType+path+sha256, entao um ref de 3 chaves apontando para um PNG entraria no fechamento de referencia e readArtifactRecords estouraria tentando parsear a imagem como JSON.
